title: The site itself
text: What every reader gets whatever page they read.

items.title: Search engines see the English site; people read English and Russian
items.text: English is open to search engines. Russian is for people and carries «noindex, follow». Public pages need no sign-in.
items.acceptance: /en pages are «index, follow», /ru pages are «noindex, follow».

items.title: The site is visible when the owner's computer is off
items.text: A page is asked from the computer first; when it does not answer, a copy kept with Cloudflare is shown.
items.acceptance: With the tunnel stopped, the public pages still open.

items.title: Analytics counts only after the reader agrees
items.text: Google Analytics is on; the cookie banner asks first, and the footer links the policy pages.

items.title: Texts change without a rebuild
items.text: The words of pages are data: a change is committed, the pages are refreshed and the Cloudflare copy is updated. A rebuild is needed only when code changes.
